caption: I went there to shoot my first music video, but came back with a moment I'll never forget. ❤️While shooting AKELAPAN, I came across a very old lady sitting on the roadside in nearly 52°C heat, asking people for help.I gave her almost all the cash I had in my pocket, around 2 - 3k . She was so old that she couldn't even figure out how much money I'd given her, so I helped her safely tuck it inside her saree.When I told her the actual amount, her eyes filled with tears. The emotion on her face at that very moment… honestly, that's something I'll carry with me forever.And that's the kind of moment I live for. ❤️Life is just one. We spend so much time chasing fame, money, glamour and success, forgetting that none of it goes with us.When we leave this world, it's the love we shared, the kindness we showed and the lives we touched that truly matter.Be successful, dream big, but never stop being human. ❤️#HumanityFirst #KindnessMatters #SpreadLove #BeKind #LifeLessons
